subject: Greenfield Medica — soft-landing concession / combined credits + discount request
messages:
From: Laura Kensington <laura.k@greenfieldmedica.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.w@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up — pilot budget & ask for combined concession

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency profile and how Redwood handles KV caching for our long-context workflows. We have an internal ask from procurement: to proceed with a 45-day pilot we need a small promotional package to mitigate the initial cost while we validate model quality at scale.

Specifically their request is: 1) $25k of free credits applied to the pilot account, 2) a 30-day trial extension (from 30 to 60 days) to accommodate our internal QA cadence, and 3) a 12% one-time discount on the first month of committed Dedicated capacity should we convert.

I understand this is an exception to standard offers. Can you flag who we should loop in for exec signoff? Procurement is hoping to finalize terms by next week.

Best,
Laura
Laura Kensington
Head of Platform Integrations
Greenfield Medica

Attachment: Procurement_Team_Q1.xlsx (stub)

From: Logan Wright <logan.w@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Kensington <laura.k@greenfieldmedica.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.b@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up — pilot budget & ask for combined concession

Hi Laura — appreciate the clarity.

We can usually handle a single axis concession (credits OR discount OR extension) without exec review, but this is a combined ask that needs approval. I'll start an internal approval thread and share the formal concession proposal for signoff.

Proposed internal approach (so you have visibility):
- Grant $20k free credits to the pilot account immediately (we can issue once paperwork is signed)
- Approve a 45-day total trial window (30 + 15 extension) to avoid gating the pilot on additional approvals
- Offer a conditional 8% one-time conversion discount on month-1 of Dedicated if they sign within 60 days of pilot start

If procurement requires full ask ($25k / 60 days / 12%), I'll escalate to leadership for a decision. Would Greenfield consider the conditional structure above? It shortens our approval path.

Talk soon — I'll follow up internally and get back by EOD.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0127

From: Logan Wright <logan.w@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.b@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.p@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: [Request] Exec approval needed: Greenfield Medica — combined concession

Team,

We have a conversion-stage pilot with Greenfield Medica (deal GF-2027-082). Summary: they want $25k credits + extend trial to 60 days + 12% conversion discount. Prospect is mid-size medical SaaS (HIPAA scope) — pilot will use Redwood Hosted initially; we will likely need a Private deployment conversation later.

Why this matters:
- Pipeline: $300k ACV conservative if they convert to Dedicated in Q4.
- Timeline: procurement wants terms by 8/31 to align procurement review.
- Risk: they need the extra runway to complete clinical QA; losing them now delays a multi-quarter opportunity.

As an alternative I proposed (to keep approvals lower): $20k credits, 45-day trial, 8% month-1 discount conditional on signing within 60 days. Greenfield hasn't accepted yet — they pushed back on the lower credit and shorter extension.

Requesting exec signoff for the full concession below or permission to offer a middle-ground: please indicate APPROVE / APPROVE WITH MOD / DENY and any guardrails.

Requested concession (full ask):
- One-time account credit: $25,000 applied to pilot billing
- Trial extension: extend pilot to total 60 days
- One-time conversion discount: 12% off month-1 of Dedicated commitment (not recurring)

Suggested guardrails if approved:
- Credits expire 90 days after grant
- Discount valid only if a signed contract is executed within 90 days of pilot start
- No other discounts stacked (standard policy)

Attachments: Greenfield_CreditScheme_v1.pdf, SOW_Draft_GM_0827.pdf (stubs)

Thanks — quick turnaround appreciated.

— Logan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.w@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.b@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.p@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Request] Exec approval needed: Greenfield Medica — combined concession

Logan / team — thanks for the clear ask and guardrails. I support approving a softened version of the request to protect both revenue and precedent. Recommendation: APPROVE with modifications.

Final approval terms I will sign off on:
- Credits: $22,500 one-time account credit for the pilot (reduces the requested $25k slightly)
- Trial extension: 45 days total (30 + 15) — we need to avoid open-ended trial windows for HIPAA-evaluations 
- Conversion discount: 10% one-time on month-1 of Dedicated, valid if contract signed within 60 days of pilot end

Conditions:
- Contract SOW must include a clause that credits are non-transferable and apply only to Redwood consumption; credits expire 90 days after issuance
- Legal to review SOW for minimal HIPAA addendum (paperwork in parallel)
- Finance to record an approval note and cap cumulative promotional exposure for this account at $25k (credits + discount impact cap)

Dylan / Kimberly — finance and legal, please confirm you can operate with the conditions above. If yes, I'll give Logan written approval to communicate to Greenfield.

— Marissa Cole
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.b@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.w@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.p@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Request] Exec approval needed: Greenfield Medica — combined concession

Marissa / team — Finance here. We can accept Marissa's modified terms. A couple of quick notes:
- We'll book the $22.5k as promotional credit (GL: Promo-2027-Q3) and set an exposure cap so total effective revenue hit from discount + credits won't exceed $25k NPV at our baseline gross margin assumption.
- Need Kimberly to confirm Legal review timeline; assuming legal signs off within 3 business days we can issue the credits the day SOW is countersigned.

Kimberly — confirm legal cadence and I'll mark approved on finance side.

— Dylan Brooks
Head of Finance Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.p@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.b@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.w@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 14:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Request] Exec approval needed: Greenfield Medica — combined concession

All — Legal here. We can review the SOW with the HIPAA addendum in parallel and provide signoff in 48–72 hours. The proposed credit/discount language is straightforward; please ensure the SOW includes:
1) Exact credit redemption mechanics and expiration (90 days from issuance)
2) A single clause documenting the one-time conversion discount and that it applies only to month-1 of Dedicated
3) Statement that pilot usage data is governed by the standard DPA unless otherwise amended

Subject to those additions, Marissa's modified concession is acceptable. Logan — you have written approval to communicate the concession to Greenfield.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
